name: presence
title: Presence
description: Collaborative-awareness presence (who's here + cursors) — a TTL'd room/session table wired into your Lunora schema, with reactive listPresent and a heartbeat upsert.
docs: Re-export the functions from lunora/presence/index.ts so codegen emits api.presence.*, then drive them from React with usePresence (see the README). Rooms are scoped server-side to the caller's tenant (the identity's orgId claim; see presenceTenant in lunora/presence/index.ts), which @lunora/auth sets from the active organization when the organization plugin is on. Tune PRESENCE_TTL_MS in lunora/presence/schema.ts.
